naiwa.configuration.title: Naiwa Settings
naiwa.configuration.prankIntervalMinSeco: Default: 300 seconds. Equal bounds give a fixed interval; both zero remove the extra wait. Existing cooldowns remain; new values apply to the next prank. Reversed bounds are sorted.
naiwa.configuration.prankIntervalMaxSeco: Default: 600 seconds. Affects the ten regular pranks only, not the initial ten-second delay, respawn/totem mockery, shield encounters or collection cooldown.
naiwa.configuration.allowConsecutiveSame: Allow consecutive pranks of the same type
Default: off. Allows, but does not force, the previous prank again after its cooldown. Trigger and safety checks still apply; scenes never overlap.
naiwa.configuration.respawnAppearDistanc: Default: 2.5 blocks. Range: 1.5–16; decimals allowed. Uses the respawned player's current position and horizontal facing. If blocked, tries 1 or 2 blocks farther, never beyond 16. Changes apply to later appearances, not an active scene.
naiwa.configuration.totemLandingAppearDi: Default: 2.5 blocks. Range: 1.5–16; decimals allowed. Adjusts the forward appearance distance after actual landing, not flight height or fall protection. If blocked, tries 1 or 2 blocks farther, never beyond 16. Changes apply to later appearances.
